Answer with edits. Each edit quotes a span of the section exactly as it is

Documentation section docs/catalogue.md#Catalogue > Removing books:

`Catalogue.remove(isbn)` drops a book and returns the `Book` it removed, so you
can put it straight onto a shelf or hand it to someone. An ISBN the catalogue
does not hold raises `KeyError`.

The chunk bookshelf/catalogue.py::Catalogue.remove before the change:

def remove(self, isbn):
    return self._books.pop(normalise(isbn))

And after it:

def remove(self, isbn):
    del self._books[normalise(isbn)]

What the change made wrong: `Catalogue.remove(isbn)` no longer returns the removed `Book`; it now deletes the entry and returns `None`.
